rule: Physical and website visits are counts; several audience-profile indicators are survey estimates and must retain that status.
Museum group totals and single-site institutions are different reporting perimeters.
V&A Dundee is excluded from the V&A dataset because it is a separate charity.
Closure/opening effects must be attached before longitudinal comparisons.
Self-generated income = fundraising/contributed income + admissions income + trading net profit in this DCMS release; do not substitute total institutional income.
The British Museum accounted for 81% of fundraising income across sponsored museums in 2024/25; aggregate fundraising therefore must not be read as typical institution-level performance.
Output indicators are not outcome/value measures and are not used to rank institutions.
